recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, tactile composition featuring a weathered black-and-white photograph taped onto a corrugated cardboard background. The aesthetic is defined by physical imperfections, including creases, masking tape, and industrial shipping stamps, creating a 'found object' or DIY archival feel.
coreVisualRelationships: The central photograph acts as a window into a different tonal space against the warm cardboard.
Industrial stamps and stenciled text provide a structural, bureaucratic contrast to the organic group photo.
The masking tape and torn edges create a sense of depth and physical layering.
The sepia and brown color palette unifies disparate elements into a singular rustic theme.
coreInvariants: Corrugated cardboard texture with visible vertical grain
Translucent masking tape with frayed edges
Distressed, low-contrast photography with physical creases

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group photograph is centered as the primary focal point, occupying approximately 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central photo, secured by tape, serves as the heavy visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left text, moves down to the central photo, and finishes at the bottom-right title, following a diagonal Z-pattern.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The cardboard margins provide significant negative space, emphasizing the 'scrapbook' or 'shipping container' concept.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted brick red (top-left text) and charcoal grey (bottom-right text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; high value contrast between the photo's highlights and the cardboard's shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Simulated ink-bleed or stencil spray effect
Rough, irregular edges to mimic physical stamping
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters show internal texture loss to simulate uneven ink application on cardboard.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed on the background layer, separate from the photo

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different colors to distinguish between artist and title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed weight and presence.
Captures the industrial, utilitarian feel of the shipping stamps.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution texture of a corrugated cardboard box with vertical seams and a circular industrial stamp in the top right. Place a weathered, creased black-and-white group photo in the center, secured by semi-translucent masking tape on the corners and sides.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply condensed, bold, distressed sans-serif text in muted red at the top left and charcoal grey at the bottom right. Ensure the text has a stamped, slightly bleeding ink texture that interacts with the cardboard grain.

verificationChecks: Is the cardboard texture visible through the lighter areas of the stamps?
Does the photo have visible physical damage like creases or tears?
Is the color palette restricted to earth tones?

adjustableVariables: Amount of physical distress on the central photo
mustRedesign: Unique brand logos or shipping certificates

avoid: Drop shadows that look like digital effects

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no digital-looking gradients are present.
Check that the tape edges look fibrous and torn.
Verify the text looks like it was physically stamped onto the surface.
Confirm the photo looks like a separate physical object.
recipe.reuseFormula: Layered [Cardboard Background] + [Distressed Photo Overlay] + [Masking Tape Assets] + [Stamped Condensed Typography]
